scope: Same 24 already-consumed primary animals; first 4000 indexed rows each; 96000 historical rows total; 1000 prefix/3000 future/six 500 bins
whole_containing_npz_members: All containing bytes were hashed and all members decoded/charged, including saved weights, probes, hidden states, count and auxiliary diagnostic arrays in the 48 forecast bundles; no original code or trajectories regenerated
bundled_summary_auxiliary: Historical persistence means and conditional endpoint arrays were decoded as parts of admitted summary bundles. Persistence was not scored or entered in a model comparison; the prior conditional sampled accuracy was reproduced only for the initial milestone
summary_metadata: Original freeze/forecast manifests and ordinary lab reports read; metadata for historically excluded/partial records does not release their numeric outcome payloads
historical_raw_counts_and_provenance: Inherited from prior original-byte and independent reconstruction audits; no new source certification
